priceSource: https://www.blocktempo.com/an-epic-trading-war-on-flow-may-be-coming/ (quotes CoinMarketCap $17.33 at time of writing, article dated 2021-10-15, one day before the unlock)
notes: DATE: CoinList's statement (via Crowdfund Insider) says community-sale and auction buyers could access, stake and trade FLOW from 15:00 UTC on 2021-10-16. BlockTempo (2021-10-15) also gives the 16th but notes that no official schedule had been published. Neither source is Flow/Dapper itself, and both describe the sale-buyer unlock. I found nothing showing the backers' 1-year cliff ended on that exact day. FIRST INSIDER: I mark this 'true' on medium evidence. ICO Drops gives backers (large and small) '24 months with a one-year cliff'. The First Mint gives the team '36-month vesting... 1-year cliff'. A Flow forum post from March 2021 says the genesis 1.25B were 'locked until Oct 2021'. So no insider cliff ended before Oct 2021. The other 50% of community-sale tokens vested monthly over the next year, and backers vest over 24 months after the cliff.

date: 2025-07-11 (scheduled date only; derived from TGE + 12-month cliff, not confirmed as actually released)

The Defiant confirms that the airdrop claim opened 11 July (2024). Together these make 2025-07-11 the scheduled first Strategic Partners tranche, but that is a date worked out from the schedule. The investor cliff on 2025-07-11 would therefore be the first insider unlock. PCT: not verified. The allocation is 13% x 8,888,888,888 = ~1.156B, and 1.156B / 18 = ~64.2M per tranche (my own arithmetic). I found no source for circulating supply just before 2025-07-11, so I could not check the claimed 1.9%. PRICE: no dated source found.

DATE (supported within 1 day): DefiLlama lists the unlock at 2025-10-14 05:30 UTC: Investors 363.33M DEEP plus Early Contributors 250M DEEP = 613.33M (my sum). Sui's own blog (primary) puts the DEEP launch on Monday 14 October (2024), 10:00 UTC. Alea Research and Backpack both describe a 1-year cliff for investors and contributors, which puts the cliff end at ~2025-10-14. Tokenomics.com gives TGE as 2024-10-13, a 1-day difference. Its recurring unlocks fall on the 14th. FIRST INSIDER: FALSE, which is why the verdict is not_first_insider. Alea Research (2024-10-14, launch day) says genesis circulation of 25% comprised '10% airdrop, 14% ecosystem reserve, 1% investors'. Backpack Learn says 'Mysten Labs receives 1% unlocked at TGE'. Tokenomics.com even lists the 'Core Contributors and Early Backers' pool at '14.0% at TGE', though it contradicts itself elsewhere. So at least ~1% of supply in insider/investor hands was transferable from Oct 2024. 2025-10-14 was the first CLIFF release for the private-sale investors and early contributors, but not the first insider liquidity. PCT: 24.53% is DefiLlama's own figure, '24.53% of float', and it equals 613.33M / 2.5B exactly. The 2.5B is the genesis float (Alea/Backpack: 25% of 10B) and is also what DefiLlama shows as current circulating. That looks like a stale float figure, not the circulating supply on 2025-10-13, which should be higher after a year of ecosystem emissions. The true pre-unlock percentage is therefore probably lower than 24.53%, but I found no dated figure. SHAPE: lump at the cliff, followed by monthly insider tranches (Tokenomics.com shows monthly 14th-of-month insider events in 2026). PRICE: DefiLlama's $12.96M valuation implies ~$0.021/DEEP, but that is at DefiLlama's current price, not the 2025-10-14 price, so I did not report it.
